# Documentation Sync Checklist

Use this checklist after architecture-affecting code changes.

- [ ] OnTick flow reflects current call order.
- [ ] New state enums and state transitions are documented.
- [ ] New/changed class responsibilities are documented.
- [ ] Dependency diagram text matches current module graph.
- [ ] Deferred functions are explicitly marked as not implemented.
- [ ] File and symbol names match source exactly.
- [ ] No contradictions between ARCHITECTURE.md and README.md.
